{{Short description|Dutch mathematician (born 1948)}}

[[File:Looijenga kurke.jpg|thumb|Looijenga with Herbert Kurke, in 2007]]
'''Eduard Jacob Neven Looijenga''' (born 30 September 1948, [[Zaandam]])<ref>[http://albumacademicum.uva.nl/id/id001143 Prof. dr. E.J.N. Looijenga, 1948 -] at Album Academicum, Universiteit van Amsterdam</ref> is a Dutch mathematician who works in [[algebraic geometry]] and the theory of [[algebraic group]]s.<ref name="knaw">[https://www.knaw.nl/en/members/members/4490 Member profile] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160303211945/https://www.knaw.nl/en/members/members/4490 |date=2016-03-03 }}, KNAW, retrieved 2015-01-26.</ref> He was a professor of mathematics at [[Utrecht University]] until his retirement in 2013.<ref name="singular">[http://www.projects.science.uu.nl/singularlife/Singular_life/Singular_life.html A singular life: in honour of Eduard Looijenga] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304065942/http://www.projects.science.uu.nl/singularlife/Singular_life/Singular_life.html |date=2016-03-04 }}, Utrecht Univ., retrieved 2015-01-26.</ref>

Looijenga studied mathematics at the [[University of Amsterdam]] beginning in 1965, and earned a master's degree there in 1971. He obtained a Dutch fellowship for two years of study at the [[Institut des Hautes Études Scientifiques]] in France, and then returned to the University of Amsterdam, earning a Ph.D. in 1974 under the supervision of [[Nicolaas Kuiper]].<ref name="cv">{{Deprecated archive|url=https://archive.today/20150127012318/http://www.staff.science.uu.nl/~looij101/CV_%26_More.html|title=Curriculum vitae}}, retrieved 2015-01-26.</ref><ref>{{mathgenealogy|id=49687}}</ref> After postdoctoral research at the [[University of Liverpool]], he took a faculty position at the [[Radboud University Nijmegen|University of Nijmegen]] in 1975, returned as a professor to the University of Amsterdam in 1987, and moved again to Utrecht in 1991. Since his 2013 retirement, he has also held a professorship at [[Tsinghua University]].<ref name="cv"/>

In 1978, Looijenga was an [[list of International Congresses of Mathematicians Plenary and Invited Speakers|invited speaker at the International Congress of Mathematicians]].<ref name="cv"/> He became a member of the [[Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences]] in 1995,<ref name="knaw"/> and in 2012 he became one of the inaugural fellows of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>[https://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society], retrieved 2015-01-25.</ref> In 2013, a conference in honor of his retirement was held at Utrecht University.<ref name="singular"/>
